title: DModE - Preprocessing
workflow_title: DModE - Differential modification and expression analysis pipeline (Preprocessing)
description: A Nextflow pipeline for modification detection and expression quantification with direct RNA Nanopore sequencing.

input.title: Input/output options
input.description: Input parameters for Preprocessing. Provide exactly one of samplesheet, pod5_dir or ubam.

samplesheet.title: Samplesheet
samplesheet.description: Tab-separated file with columns sample, condition, input.
samplesheet.help_text: 'input' is a POD5 directory/.pod5 file (basecalled with Dorado) or an unaligned BAM (basecalling is skipped). POD5 and BAM inputs can be mixed. 'condition' is required for the DModE analysis. Use instead of 'Pod5 folder' or 'Unaligned BAM'.

pod5_dir.title: Pod5 folder
pod5_dir.description: Path to the directory containing POD5 files only.
pod5_dir.help_text: Single-sample alternative to the samplesheet; the folder name is used as sample ID. DModE is skipped.

ubam.title: Unaligned BAM
ubam.description: Already basecalled, unaligned BAM from Dorado (basecalling is skipped).
ubam.help_text: Single-sample alternative to the samplesheet; the file name is used as sample ID. If the BAM was basecalled with modification models, set 'mods' to those models to run modkit. DModE is skipped.

ref_genome.title: Genome reference
ref_genome.description: Path to the reference genome in FASTA format.
ref_genome.help_text: The reference genome to which the basecalled reads will be aligned.

ref_transcriptome.title: Transcriptome reference
ref_transcriptome.description: Path to the reference transcriptome in FASTA format.
ref_transcriptome.help_text: The reference transcriptome to which the basecalled reads will be aligned.

genome_gtf.title: Genome annotation
genome_gtf.description: Path to the genome annotation file in GTF format.
genome_gtf.help_text: The GTF file containing genome annotations.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.
outdir.help_text: Results will be organized in subdirectories for each analysis step.

publish_mode.title: Publish Mode
publish_mode.description: Method for saving results (symlink or copy).
publish_mode.help_text: Select 'symlink' to link files (saves disk space) or 'copy' to duplicate them (safer for long-term storage).

model.title: Dorado model
model.description: Basecalling model alias or full name
model.help_text: Use 'fast', 'hac', or 'sup' for automatic detection, or provide a full model name for reproducibility.

mods.title: Should modifications be detected ?
mods.description: Comma-separated modification models (e.g. 'm6A_DRACH' or 'inosine_m6A_2OmeA,pseU_2OmeU'). For BAM input: the models the BAM was basecalled with.
mods.help_text: Set to false to disable modification calling and modkit pileup.

max_reads.title: Maximum reads per sample
max_reads.description: Basecall only the first N reads per sample (Dorado --max-reads), e.g. for test runs. 0 = all reads.

modkit_mod_threshold.title: Modification confidence threshold
modkit_mod_threshold.description: Per-modification probability threshold for Modkit pileup.
modkit_mod_threshold.help_text: Minimum probability to count a call as modified.

modkit_filter_threshold.title: Filter threshold
modkit_filter_threshold.help_text: Minimum probability to consider a site as modified.

use_gpu.title: Which GPU should be used (cuda:0-cuda:4,cuda:all options)
use_gpu.help_text: Enable GPU acceleration for faster basecalling. Disable if no GPU is available.

cpus.title: Number of threads/cpus
cpus.help_text: 0: alignment, modkit and oarfish get half of --max_cpus, Dorado 12, all other steps 4. A value > 0 gives every job exactly that many threads (capped at --max_cpus).

max_basecalling.title: Parallel basecalling jobs
max_basecalling.description: Number of Dorado basecalling jobs running at the same time

max_alignments.title: Parallel alignment jobs
max_alignments.description: Number of minimap2 jobs running at the same time (separately for genome and transcriptome)
max_alignments.help_text: Genome alignment needs ~19 GB RAM per job.

max_cpus.title: Maximum total CPUs
max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs used by all running jobs together (0 = all cores)
max_cpus.help_text: Jobs are only started while the sum of their CPUs fits into this budget. --cpus is capped at this value.

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Advanced options for configuring processes inside the workflow.
advanced_options.help_text: These advanced options do not need to be changed for typical use, but allow fine tuning of workflows for users who want more control over the workflow.

disable_ping.description: Enable to prevent sending a workflow ping.

dmode_options.title: DModE options
dmode_options.description: Differential expression and modification analysis after preprocessing (samplesheet input only).

run_dmode.title: Run DModE
run_dmode.description: Run DModE after preprocessing. Requires a samplesheet with at least two conditions.

reference_levels.title: Reference condition(s)
reference_levels.description: Comma-separated control condition(s) from the samplesheet.

dmode_level.title: Analysis level
dmode_level.description: Gene level (featureCounts + genome modkit) and/or transcript level (oarfish + transcriptome modkit).

dmode_coverage.title: Minimum coverage
dmode_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage of a modification site.

dmode_frequency.title: Minimum modification frequency (%)
dmode_frequency.description: Minimum modification frequency of a site.

dmode_modifications.title: Modification types
dmode_modifications.description: Comma-separated types to analyse (m6A, Am, Ino, pseU, Um, Gm, Cm, m5C). Default: all present.

dmode_basic_statistics.title: DModE basic statistics
dmode_basic_statistics.description: Also run dmode <level>_basic_statistics (PCA, UMAP, site counts, distributions, sample correlation). Needs --mods.

dmode_container.title: DModE container
dmode_container.description: Container image used for the DModE step.

resources.run_time: ~10 hours per sample, highly dependent on dataset size
